goal: Stop a verification guard from voiding correct sweeps, the costliest live friction in the last 3 days of records.
notes: Critique lens: the per-run doc_friction of 2026-11-11..13 grouped by file (986 records). run_workflow_locally.py's two live reports both said that committing mid-sweep voided the verdicts; 11 run records had lost a sweep that way. Fixed: the stability fingerprint now reads tracked worktree content (index blob id when clean, git hash-object when dirty), so a commit is invariant while an edit, merge or branch checkout still trips it; the drift line names up to 5 moved paths; a moved HEAD over identical content prints a note. Verified here: 171 tests in platform/ci/test_run_workflow_locally.py (incl. a real-git class: stage, fingerprint, commit, fingerprint, equal), prompts-ci.yml replayed locally 2/2 steps green (promptctl validate + unittest discover -s prompts), platform/pages writing+heading-order 41/41, check_post_frontmatter on the new post exit 0, main_health.py 62/62 green before the change, and on this branch the real repo gave digest 3190ff9b8b3a907f at HEAD 172ca5651 and again at HEAD 5960bfa59 after the commit. Cost: 58,173 paths in ~0.1 s. No backlog ids touched. Side observation, not acted on: supersede_check.py could not finish on #12885/#12939/#12975, but their prompt.md step-0 text is already on main word for word (read via MCP get_diff); each still carries a run record not on main, so closing them would drop that, which is the owner's call on control-plane PRs.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
